title: Black Friday for cross-border shoppers: reaching Asia without changing shipping
summary: A short LinkedIn teaser for an article on how US brands can capture Black Friday demand from expats and internationally minded shoppers in Asia. Dustin Howes points to a commission and a whitelisted address as the path, without altering how brands ship.

principles.text: Black Friday demand is global; overlooked international shoppers represent sales US brands are missing.
principles.quote: Black Friday isn't just an American shopping holiday anymore.

principles.text: Expats and internationally minded shoppers plan purchases around US sales events, so brands can tap that demand.
principles.quote: Expats and internationally minded shoppers across Asia plan their buying around it too. For many US brands, those are sales they're missing.

principles.text: Reach cross-border shoppers without overhauling shipping: use a commission and a whitelisted address via a forwarding partner.
principles.quote: how brands can reach these shoppers without changing how they ship. His answer comes down to a commission and a whitelisted address.
